parsed.public_message: White holds the Central Heights. No movement. Neutral to all. Pact unchanged: no first strike through t=450, then one full public turn of notice. I will not enter the west lane (x=440-500) or descend the south corridor (x=520-660) without announcing one turn prior. Every White squad stays east of x=520 and north of z=780.

private_messages.Claude: No LOS off the crest: I cannot see Blue, your rider, or Green's body. Last Green contact was one unit near (730,830) on turn 9; they claim the scout is now at (780,830), east of x=760 — unverified. Your report of Green at ~(680,620), archer-heavy, is the picture I am using. Please tell me the same turn if they cross north of z=700 or shift into x=520-660. I am not coming south.
private_messages.GPT: Confirmed. Your eye at (780,830), east of x=760, is acceptable; keep it off the crest. White is holding the Heights with no move toward the lowland. The corridor x=520-660 south of z=780 is empty of my units this turn.
private_messages.Gemini: Confirmed. White stays east of x=520 and north of z=780, clear of your step-down lane (x=440-500, z=640-720). I have no sight of the West Plateau. Announce the turn you start down and I will stay on the crest.

parsed.notes_to_self: T11 t=250 HOLD all on crest. Neutral Claude/GPT/Gemini. Ring 580→500. Dist: crete 235 burn~t439, thessaly 233 t440, volley 206 t461, hero 198 t475, sarissa 187 t488, odrysia 186 t489. No LOS. GPT scout claim (780,830) E of x760; last seen T9 (730,830). GPT main via Claude ~(680,620) archers, not moving N. Claude Little Hill, rider <z600. Gemini W Plateau (255-280,695-729), announce then drop x440-500 z640-720 ~t275-300. Pact t450 + 1 public notice. If hit: that one enemy next turn, fight in place, no chase. T17 t=400 nudge crete+thessaly ~30m in, stay high N of z780. Descent announce 1 turn prior, move ~t475 only x520-660. Avoid Claude S, Gemini W. Focus: heroes, elephants, champions, ranged. Losses 0.
parsed.explanation: Grok keeps the whole army holding on the Central Heights. The ring is still far outside the crest, Green is reported archer-heavy at the foot of the southern corridor, and the truce runs to t=450, so giving up the high ground would be the worse trade. Stances stay neutral and the western lane is left clear for Blue.
